slides.texte_overlay:
5 habits that will pull you out
of your dopamine addiction

one screen free morning

keep one morning a week completely free of screens until noon. it feels strange at first, then it quietly becomes the calmest and clearest part of your week.

phone in a drawer

keep your phone in a drawer while you work, not on the desk. out of sight really does mean out of mind, and your focus lasts so much longer than you'd expect.

boredom on purpose

sit for ten minutes a day with nothing to do and nothing to look at. boredom is uncomfortable at first, then your brain starts creating its own ideas again.

learn instead of scroll

when you catch yourself scrolling, swap it for 5 minutes of learning: a planet, a painting, a moment in history. a real reward slowly replaces the empty one.

slow hobbies

pick a slow hobby like knitting, drawing or gardening. rewards that take time to arrive teach your brain to enjoy patience again, slowly, one day at a time.
